mass_default_basis: Unverified archival light-weight reference; current restored vessel may differ.
hull_shape_status: Approximate gull-wing visual envelope reconstructed from archival afloat/ashore photos and model references; no measured offsets.
engine_reported_basis: User prior conversation 2025; current engine identity, installed mass and position unconfirmed.
notes: Outer shape, cabin heights and window proportions are fitted reference geometry, not surveyed construction dimensions.
